column_description: A VARCHAR(50) primary key uniquely identifying each equipment record.
An enum (EquipmentType_enum) specifying the category of equipment (e.g., Shelter, Scientific, Safety, Vehicle, Generator, Communication).
A VARCHAR(80) describing the model name/number of the equipment.
A VARCHAR(120) naming the manufacturer or brand of the equipment.
A SMALLINT indicating the expected or recommended service life (in years).
A NUMERIC(5,2) showing the approximate utilization percentage (e.g., 75.00%).
A NUMERIC(6,3) representing a reliability metric or score for the equipment.
A NUMERIC(7,2) measuring the performance level of the equipment.
A REAL value indicating the efficiency rating or ratio.
A DECIMAL(5,3) capturing the safety rating index for the equipment.
A DOUBLE PRECISION value denoting the environmental impact rating.
